project_type: Full-stack monorepo: React 18 (Create React App) + Node.js/Express + MongoDB Atlas
build_system: npm workspaces for monorepo, react-scripts (CRA) for client, nodemon for server dev
test_framework: Jest + React Testing Library (client), Jest + Supertest (server)
build_command: npm run build:all (builds both client and server)
test_command: npm run test:all (runs tests in both workspaces)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run install:all from root to install all dependencies. 2. Start MongoDB (Atlas or local). 3. Configure .env files in client/ and server/ from .env.example templates. 4. Run npm run start:all to start both dev servers (client :3000, server :5000). 5. Run npm run test:all to execute all tests. 6. For backend: verify test coverage ≥70% with npm test -- --coverage in server/. 7. For Docker: docker-compose up --build to test containerized deployment. 8. For CI/CD: push to trigger GitHub Actions workflows.
snapshot_or_generated_files: client/build/ (production build of React app, generated by npm run build in client/, not checked in). Git history preservation critical: existing src/, public/ moved to client/ using git mv to preserve blame/history.
environment_constraints: Must use git mv for all file moves to preserve Git history. MongoDB Atlas free tier assumed (512MB). Cloudinary account required for image uploads (free tier 25GB). SMTP provider for Nodemailer (Gmail/SendGrid/Mailgun). Deployment target: Railway or Render (both support Node + MongoDB Atlas free tier). Windows PowerShell environment.
contribution_requirements: Preserve Git history when restructuring (git mv only). Maintain existing React 18 setup - enhance, don't replace. French language UI throughout. Responsive 320px-1920px. Backend test coverage minimum 70%. All secrets in .env files, never in code. .env files must be in .gitignore before any commits.
key_patterns: Existing React components use Framer Motion for animations. Tailwind CSS with custom theme (designColor: #edff20, bodyColor: #191919, glassmorphism aesthetic). Component structure follows feature-based organization. API calls via axios. JWT stored in localStorage. State management via Context API (AuthContext for auth). Express REST API with controller/route separation. Mongoose models with schema validation. Middleware pattern for auth, validation, error handling. Joi for input validation. bcrypt for password hashing (12 rounds). Helmet, CORS, rate-limiter, mongo-sanitize, HPP for security.
directory_structure: Current: root contains React app (src/, public/, package.json). Target: root with client/ (React app moved here) + server/ (new Express backend) + .github/workflows/ (CI/CD) + Docker files. Client structure: src/components/ reorganized into layout/, hero/, about/, skills/, projects/, blog/, contact/, common/, dashboard/. src/pages/ for Portfolio and Dashboard pages. src/services/ for API client. src/context/ for AuthContext. Server structure: config/ (db, cloudinary, env), middleware/ (auth, validation, security), models/ (Mongoose schemas), routes/ (Express routers), controllers/ (business logic), utils/ (helpers), scripts/ (seed data), tests/ (Jest tests).
